tasks.label: Run Current SQL with SQLite
tasks.command: target="${file}"; if [[ "$target" != *.sql ]]; then target="${workspaceFolder}/Lab/test.sql"; fi; echo "⚡ Executing $(basename "$target") on lab.db..."; (echo ".changes on"; cat "$target") | sqlite3 -table "${workspaceFolder}/Lab/lab.db"; echo "✅ Finished."
